headline: 'Serious threat'. China is taking over another market. Expert proposes an exit
summary: The Association of Producers and Distributors of Working Machines warns of expanding Chinese construction machinery manufacturers in Europe and Poland. An industry expert proposes an exit response.
why: Construction machinery makers supply the infrastructure and building sectors, and competition from Chinese manufacturers affects European industrial market share.
